spec.description: Isolation and correctness validation after a computation-only restore; independent fresh warmup and A/A. No algorithm speed claim.
spec.label: Periodic CRIU checkpoint rotation and distinct fresh L2 epoch qualification

failure: fresh benchmark epoch failed; measurement is not retried

command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Runs inside the pinned task image. argv[1] is literal spec JSON, not code.
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR"
finish() {
  run_exit=$?
  trap - EXIT TERM INT
  set +e
  printf '{"exit_code":%s,"job_name":"%s","pod_uid":"%s","node_name":"%s"}\n' "$run_exit" "$ISOLAB_JOB_ID" "$POD_UID" "$NODE_NAME" > "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/job-exit.json"
  (
    set -e
    cd "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR"
    shopt -s globstar nullglob
    for artifact in **/*; do
      if [[ -f "$artifact" && "$artifact" != SHA256SUMS ]]; then sha256sum "$artifact"; fi
    done
  ) > "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/SHA256SUMS"
  hash_exit=$?
  if [[ "$hash_exit" != 0 ]]; then exit 90; fi
  if aws s3 cp "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/" "$ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI" --recursive --only-show-errors; then
    printf 'Artifacts saved: %s\n' "$ISOLAB_RESULTS_URI"
  else
    exit 91
  fi
  exit "$run_exit"
}
trap finish EXIT
trap 'exit 143' TERM
trap 'exit 130' INT
cp /opt/isolab/build-info.json "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/build-info.json"
sha256sum /usr/local/bin/ecbench > "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/binary.sha256"
# Validate build identity before any warmup or measured execution.
jq -e --arg source "${2:?expected source revision}" --arg binary "${3:?expected binary hash}" \
  '.source_revision==$source and .ecbench_sha256==$binary' \
  "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/build-info.json" >/dev/null || exit 44
[[ $(cut -d' ' -f1 "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/binary.sha256") == "$3" ]] || exit 44
printf '%s\n' "$1" > "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/input-spec.json"
spec="$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/input-spec.json"
jq -e '.schema == "ecbench.spec/v1" and .measurement.isolation_required == "L2"
  and .measurement.rounds >= 5 and .measurement.warmup >= 1
  and ([.arms[] | select(.role == "reference")] | length > 0)
  and ([.arms[] | select(.role == "control")] | length > 0)' "$spec" >/dev/null
aws sts get-caller-identity > "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/runner-identity.json"
cat /proc/self/status > "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/process-status.txt"
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpuset.cpus.effective > "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/pod-cpuset.txt"
# A separate whole core remains for the parent shell and harness. No busy
# override, threshold override, automatic retry, or selective record removal.
sleep 60
ecbench run --spec "$spec" --out "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/session" --cpus auto > "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/run-summary.json" 2> "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/run.stderr"
ecbench verify --dir "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/session" --replay-all --exit-code --out "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/audit.json" > "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/audit.stdout" 2> "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/audit.stderr"
cat "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/audit.stderr"
jq -e '.ok and .regraded and .records_bound and .records>0
  and .verified_records==.records and (.replays|length)>0
  and all(.replays[]; .reproduced==true)' "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/audit.json" >/dev/null || exit 41
# The audit authenticates and regrades the records; this additional gate
# rejects a correct computation whose measurement did not achieve L2.
jq -s '{required:"L2",executions:length,
  invalid_outcomes:[.[] | select(.outcome.status != "verified" or .outcome.matches_target != true) | {seq,arm,outcome}],
  below_l2:[.[] | select(.isolation.level != "L2" and .isolation.level != "L3") | {seq,arm,isolation}],
  grades:(group_by(.isolation.level)|map({level:.[0].isolation.level,count:length}))}
  | .accepted=(.executions > 0 and (.below_l2|length)==0 and (.invalid_outcomes|length)==0)' \
  "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/session/records.jsonl" > "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/l2-gate.json"
jq -e '.accepted' "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/l2-gate.json" >/dev/null || exit 42
reference=$(jq -r '.arms[] | select(.role=="reference") | .name' "$spec" | head -1)
control=$(jq -r '.arms[] | select(.role=="control") | .name' "$spec" | head -1)
ecbench compare --dir "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/session" --a "$reference" --b "$control" --json \
  > "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/control-comparison.json"
jq -e '.wall.status=="admitted" and .wall.pairs_below_level==0 and .wall.aa_pairs>=5
  and .wall.aa_ci95!=null' "$ISOLAB_OUTPUT_DIR/control-comparison.json" >/dev/null || exit 43
